check_kinds.fixed_m: V4 (1) (4.2): q = m_hat/L_ref; m-dependent keys are parametric (terms + fixed_m_evaluation)
check_kinds.ratio: V4 (2) (4.3): m_ref = 1/A_total of the same source row; four-corner interval; single_loss_weight is the identity of 4.4(5)
check_kinds.seed_area: V5 (4.5(1)): window_area.term_13a of the source row in area units

metadata.file_hash_note: the SHA-256 of this file is recorded separately before any comparison (prereg 4.1)
fixed_m_evaluation: m = Fr(m_hat): the reported binary64 multiplier read as an exact rational; m must be finite and > 0
all strings in terms are exact rationals (decimals or num/den)
value = r rounded to 40 significant digits, nearest, ties to even (0 stays "0")
u_r = (u + |value - r|) rounded up to 40 significant digits
d_abs = d rounded down to 40 significant digits; the exact d is used in the comparison
if r == 0: d_rel = null; the key is no_reference unless u <= d/4 and u_r <= d/4
if r != 0: d_rel = max(8*u/|r|, epsrel_exact) rounded down; the key is no_reference when this value or max(8*u_r/|value|, epsrel_exact) exceeds 1e-4
substitute once per run; record the hex of m_hat and value, u_r, d_abs, d_rel in the run ledger

generator.imports: standard library only; the package under test is not imported

s2_map.denominator: 4.4(5), 4.5(2): beta-stage denominator of the run; no mapped reference
s2_map.multiplier_A: 4.4(5): bit check RN(1/A_total^beta) against the run's own area
s2_map.multiplier_interval_A: 4.5(2): bit check against the run's own area and error (c = 0, total)
s2_map.returned_errors: 4.4(4): bit checks of the returned errors

seed_reference.seed.error13: 4.5(1): e_y of the area comparison (an estimate, not a referenced value)
seed_reference.weight_length_A: 4.5(2): bit check RN(1/D) against the run's own area and c

precision.arithmetic: exact rationals; source decimals and binary64 inputs are read exactly
precision.d_abs: rounded down; d_abs_exact holds the exact rational that the comparison uses
precision.d_rel: max(8*u/|r|, epsrel) with the exact mapped u and r, rounded down; epsrel = Fr(1e-6); null when r = 0; the 1e-4 limit is tested on the exact value and on the stored value and u_r

floors.B_A0: Fr(area_epsabs) of the source row; 1e-18 (exact) for CE rows
floors.dE: exact difference of the bin edges

precision.interval: outward (lower end down, upper end up); interval_exact holds the exact ends
precision.u_r: max distance from the stored value to the exact interval ends, rounded up (covers the source interval and the decimal rounding of the center; an exact center adds nothing)
precision.value: nearest, ties to even; exact zero is "0"
